notes.title: Game Update V1.08
notes.content:
[olist]
Added cowgirl position animations (two posture variations) and transitions between them.

[img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3458320/60ccee9f2fecc20176d5c321c98bdf2d90bf073b/ss_60ccee9f2fecc20176d5c321c98bdf2d90bf073b.1920x1080.jpg?t=1749610672"]

Adjusted the weight settings(weight paint) for the breast and fur parts of the Christmas costume.

Breast bounce triggered when clothes come off.

I tweaked the auto mode to feel more powerful and added 4 types of auto motion paths to the cowgirl (leaning back) position, and implemented a feature that automatically switches between them.

In missionary, if tits are being grabbed during ejaculation, the grabbing motion will pause.

Motion speed slows down for 1 second after ejaculation.

Initial excitement  level has been adjusted to 3.（will be overridden if loading saved data）.

Adjusted scene lighting.

Set maximum volume to 20.
[/olist]

notes.title: Notice on Delayed Update and Re-Release
notes.content:
The game is currently heavily pirated. To prevent new content from becoming exclusive to pirate copies, I’ll need to resume sales.
I plan to start the re-release process in June, so the update will come after that.

※ If you already own the game, you won’t need to buy it again — updates will still be delivered as usual.

notes.title: Release and Patch Notes (V1.05)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Q9nTWhwX4B0;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is officially released.
Yesterday, I tried to mess with my game using the most brute-force menu inputs—and sure enough, I broke it.

🛠️ V1.05 Bug Fix Notes

🎮 Camera and Menu Interaction Fixes:
The main issue showed up when I repeatedly pressed
Show Outfit >>> Sit Down—
It became painfully obvious something was off.

This update makes the game more stable overall.

Minor Adjustments:
Facial expression transitions are now smoother.
